strings: While the rest of the Clan settles down for the night, m_c is getting up every few hours to check and make sure that things are still safe and fine.
m_c keeps waking up {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} denmates to get them to check just one more time if they are really sure the camp is secure.
m_c has been extra paranoid this moon.

{PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/are/is} not paranoid, m_c insists, that it's just the proper level of caution as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/check/checks} for the third time that afternoon that the nursery is secure.
m_c feels rooted in place while it feels like something large looms in the shadows, hunting specifically for {PRONOUN/m_c/object}
Even with all of r_c's assurances, m_c is certain that there is something out there, hunting for {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
